title: just released an old game of mine on itch for free
author: Inbellator
selftext:
This is an old game of mine I thought i'd release for free as these games are getting much easier to make. I use Gemini 3, started it a year ago with on and off dev and then just finished it up a few months back with newer Ai, took a lot of prompts back last year lol!

  
just thought i'd post if anyone wants to have a try! thanks :)  
  
[https://memashgames.itch.io/turbotapper](https://memashgames.itch.io/turbotapper)
